text: attractive
привабливий
Who do you find attractive, and why?
I find people attractive when they smile a lot and seem kind.
Why is your sister wearing make-up today? Is she trying to look attractive for someone?
Yes, she's meeting her new boyfriend tonight, so she's trying to look attractive.
slim
струнка/й
What do you usually do to stay slim?
I usually walk to school and I rarely eat fast food, so I stay slim.
Your brother looks slimmer. What is he doing differently these days?
He's going to the gym three times a week and he's eating less sugar these days.
curly
кучерявий
Does your best friend have curly or straight hair?
She has curly red hair. She doesn't like it, but I love it.
Why is your hair curly today? It's usually straight.
I'm trying a new style. I'm using a curling iron this week.
straight
прямий, рівний
Is your hair naturally straight?
Yes, my hair is naturally straight, and it never stays curly for long.
Why are you holding a hair straightener? Are you making your hair straight?
Yes, I'm making it straight because I'm going to a party tonight.
medium-height
середнього зросту
Are most people in your family medium-height?
Yes, most of us are medium-height, but my dad is quite tall.
Is your little brother still growing, or is he medium-height now?
He's still growing. He's getting taller every month, but he's medium-height for his age.
well-built
спортивна статура
Do athletes usually look well-built?
Yes, most athletes train every day, so they usually look well-built.
Your cousin looks really well-built now. What is he doing?
He's training for a boxing competition, so he's lifting weights every day.
overweight
із зайвою вагою
Why do many people become overweight?
Many people become overweight because they eat too much and don't exercise.
Is the number of overweight children growing in your country?
Yes, it's growing because children are spending more time in front of screens.
pale
блідий
You look pale. Do you feel OK?
No, I don't feel very well. I think I have a cold.
Why is your face getting so pale?
Because I'm working too much and I'm not sleeping well this week.
stocky
кремезний
What does a stocky person look like?
A stocky person usually has a short, wide and strong body.
Do you think stocky players are good at rugby?
Yes, I think they are. They don't fall over easily, and they're hard to stop.
muscular
м'язистий
How often do you need to train to become muscular?
You usually need to train at least three times a week, and you always need to eat enough protein.
Is your friend getting more muscular?
Yes, he's getting more muscular because he's doing push-ups every morning.
elegant
елегантний
Who always looks elegant in your family?
My grandmother always looks elegant. She never wears jeans.
Why are you wearing such an elegant dress today?
I'm wearing it because I'm going to my cousin's wedding this afternoon.
freckled
ластовинний
Does anyone in your class have a freckled face?
Yes, my friend Olya has a freckled face, and she really loves her freckles.
Why is your nose getting more freckled?
Because it's summer and I'm spending a lot of time in the sun.
bald
лисий
Why do some men go bald?
Some men go bald because of their genes. It often runs in the family.
Is your dad going bald?
Yes, he's slowly going bald, so he's thinking about shaving his head.
wrinkled
зморшкуватий
What makes skin wrinkled?
The sun and smoking make skin wrinkled, and it also happens naturally with age.
Why is your shirt so wrinkled?
Because my iron is broken, so I'm wearing wrinkled clothes this week.
tanned
засмаглий
Do you usually get tanned in summer?
Yes, I usually get tanned quickly because I spend a lot of time outside.
You look tanned! Are you spending a lot of time at the beach?
Yes, I'm staying with my grandparents by the sea this month.
ambitious
амбітний
What does an ambitious person do?
An ambitious person sets big goals and works hard to achieve them.
What ambitious plans are you working on at the moment?
I'm learning English and I'm saving money because I want to study abroad.
confident
впевнений
Do you feel confident when you speak English?
Not always. I feel confident with friends, but I don't like speaking in front of the class.
Are you becoming more confident this year?
Yes, I'm becoming more confident because I'm practising speaking every day.
determined
рішучий
What do determined people do when they fail?
Determined people don't give up. They try again and learn from their mistakes.
What are you determined to achieve this term, and what are you doing to get there?
I'm determined to pass my exams, so I'm studying for two hours every evening this term.
generous
щедрий
Who is the most generous person you know, and what do they do?
My aunt is very generous. She often buys presents for everyone and always helps her neighbours.
Why is your brother being so generous today?
He's being generous because he wants to borrow my bike. He's usually quite selfish!
outgoing
товариський
Are you outgoing or shy?
I'm quite outgoing. I love meeting new people and I often go to parties.
Is your new classmate making friends? She seems outgoing.
Yes, she's making friends quickly. She's talking to everyone this week.
reliable
надійний
What does a reliable friend do?
A reliable friend always keeps promises and never lets you down.
Do you believe your best friend is reliable?
Yes, I believe he is. I trust him completely.
sensitive
чутливий
Do sensitive people cry easily?
Yes, sensitive people often cry easily, and they notice other people's feelings.
Why is your sister being so sensitive today?
She's being sensitive because she's worrying about her exam tomorrow.
stubborn
впертий
What does a stubborn person usually do in an argument?
A stubborn person never changes their mind, even when they know they're wrong.
Is your stubborn grandad still refusing to buy a new phone?
Yes, he's still using his old phone. He says it works perfectly.
creative
творчий
How do creative people spend their free time?
Creative people often draw, write or make music in their free time.
What creative project are you working on now?
I'm making a short film with my friends. We're filming it this month.
honest
чесний
Do you prefer honest friends or polite ones?
I prefer honest friends. I want to know the truth, even if it hurts.
Are you being honest with me right now?
Yes, I'm being completely honest. I'm telling you everything I know.
patient
терплячий
Are teachers usually patient?
Good teachers are usually patient. They explain things again and again.
Are you learning to be more patient?
Yes, I'm learning. I'm trying not to get angry in traffic jams.
cheerful
веселий
How often are you cheerful in the morning?
I'm rarely cheerful in the morning. I'm usually tired until I have breakfast.
Why are you so cheerful today? What's happening?
My best friend is visiting me this weekend, so I'm feeling really cheerful.
shy
сором'язливий
What do shy people usually do at parties?
Shy people usually stand in the corner and don't talk to many people.
Is your brother getting less shy now?
Yes, he's getting less shy because he's going to a drama club.
sociable
комунікабельний
Do sociable people like working in teams?
Yes, sociable people usually enjoy teamwork because they like talking to others.
Are you having a party this weekend? You're so sociable!
Yes, I'm having a party on Saturday. I have lots of friends, and I'm inviting all of them.
impulsive
імпульсивний
What do impulsive people do when they go shopping?
Impulsive people often buy things they don't need without thinking.
Why are you buying another jacket? Isn't that impulsive?
Maybe, but it's on sale, and I'm not spending much money this month.
acquaintance
знайомий
Do you know many people well, or are most of them acquaintances?
I know a lot of people, but most of them are acquaintances, not close friends.
Who is that acquaintance you're talking to?
She's an acquaintance from my gym. We're chatting about a new class.
colleague
колега
How often do your parents meet their colleagues outside work?
My mum sometimes meets her colleagues for coffee, but my dad never does.
What are your mum's colleagues working on at the moment?
They're preparing a big presentation, so they're staying late at the office this week.
flatmate
сусід по квартирі
What does a good flatmate do?
A good flatmate cleans the kitchen, pays the bills on time and respects your space.
Why is your flatmate cooking so much food?
She's cooking for her birthday party. She's inviting ten people tonight.
neighbour
сусід
Do you get on well with your neighbours?
Yes, I get on well with them. We often say hello and help each other.
What's that noise? What are your neighbours doing?
They're building a new garage, so they're making a lot of noise all week.
rival
суперник
Which team is your football team's biggest rival?
Our biggest rival is the team from the next town. We play them twice a year.
Do you think your rival is better than you?
I don't think so. I believe I'm just as good, but he trains more.
ex-partner
колишній партнер
Do people often stay friends with their ex-partners?
Some people do, but many people don't keep in touch with their ex-partners.
Is your aunt talking to her ex-partner again?
Yes, they're talking again because they're organising their son's birthday party.
stepbrother
зведений брат
How often do you see your stepbrother?
I see my stepbrother every weekend because he lives with his mum during the week.
What is your stepbrother doing these days?
He's studying at university and he's working part-time in a café.
mentor
наставник
What does a mentor do?
A mentor gives advice and helps a younger person to develop their skills.
Is your mentor helping you with anything at the moment?
Yes, she's helping me to prepare for a job interview this week.
spouse
подружжя
Do spouses usually share the housework in your country?
More and more spouses share the housework, but women still do most of it.
Does your uncle's spouse own a business?
Yes, she owns a small bakery, and it belongs to her family.
sibling
брат або сестра
How many siblings do you have?
I have two siblings: an older brother and a younger sister.
What are your siblings doing right now?
My brother is playing computer games and my sister is doing her homework.
fiancé
наречений/наречена
When do people call someone their fiancé?
People call someone their fiancé when they plan to get married.
Are your cousin and her fiancé planning the wedding now?
Yes, they're looking for a venue and they're writing the guest list.
companion
супутник, товариш
Why do many old people have a dog as a companion?
Because a dog keeps them company and they don't feel lonely.
Who is your travel companion on this trip?
My best friend is travelling with me. We're staying in a hostel in Lviv.
housemate
сусід по будинку
How often do you and your housemates clean the house?
We usually clean it every Saturday, but we sometimes forget.
Why is your housemate packing his bags?
He's moving out because he's starting a new job in another city.
classmate
однокласник
Do you help your classmates with homework?
Yes, I often help my classmates with maths, and they help me with English.
What are your classmates doing during the break?
Some are eating snacks, some are chatting, and a few are checking their phones.
partner
партнер
Do you prefer working alone or with a partner?
I prefer working with a partner because I like sharing ideas.
Who is your partner for the science project this term?
I'm working with Max this term. We're building a model of a volcano.
broadcast
трансляція, мовлення
Which event did you last watch as a live broadcast?
I watched the Eurovision final as a live broadcast last May.
What were you doing when the news broadcast started?
I was cooking dinner when the news broadcast started, so I only listened to it.
podcast
подкаст
What was the last podcast you listened to?
I listened to a history podcast on the bus yesterday.
Did you use to listen to podcasts a few years ago?
No, I didn't use to listen to podcasts. I used to listen to music on the radio.
headline
заголовок
Did you see any shocking headlines while you were scrolling this morning?
Yes, while I was scrolling, I saw a headline about a huge storm in Spain.
Why did the headline surprise so many people?
It surprised them because nobody had expected the team to win the cup.
tabloid
таблоїд (жовта преса)
Did your grandparents use to read tabloids?
My grandad used to read a tabloid every morning, but my grandma never did.
What story did the tabloids publish last week?
They published a story about a famous singer's secret wedding.
broadsheet
серйозна газета
When did you last read a broadsheet newspaper?
I last read a broadsheet two months ago, while I was waiting at the dentist's.
Are you used to reading long articles in broadsheets?
Not yet, but I'm getting used to it. The language is harder than in tabloids.
journalist
журналіст
What was the journalist doing when the fire started?
She was interviewing the mayor when the fire started, so she ran outside to film it.
What did journalists use to do before the internet?
They used to write on typewriters and send their stories by fax or phone.
editor
редактор
Why did the editor reject the article?
She rejected it because the journalist hadn't checked the facts.
What did the editor change in your article?
She cut two paragraphs and changed the headline.
issue
випуск, номер; проблема
What was on the cover of the last issue of your favourite magazine?
There was a photo of a famous footballer on the cover of the last issue.
Why couldn't you buy the new issue?
When I got to the shop, the new issue had already sold out.
subscriber
підписник
Did your family use to be subscribers to a newspaper?
Yes, we used to be subscribers to a local newspaper, but we cancelled it last year.
What happened while the YouTuber was streaming live?
While she was streaming, she reached a million subscribers, and she started to cry.
audience
аудиторія, глядачі
How did the audience react at the end of the concert?
The audience stood up and clapped for five minutes.
What was the audience doing when the lights went out?
They were watching the final scene when the lights suddenly went out.
streaming
потокове мовлення
How did people use to watch films before streaming?
They used to rent DVDs or wait for films to appear on TV.
What series were you streaming last night at midnight?
I was streaming a Korean drama. I couldn't stop!
content
контент, вміст
What content did you post online last week?
I posted a short video of my dog playing in the snow.
Was it hard to get used to creating content every day?
At first it was hard, but now I'm used to creating content every day.
correspondent
кореспондент
What was happening when the correspondent reported the news?
She was standing in front of the parliament building, and it was raining heavily.
Had the correspondent worked in a war zone before?
Yes, she had already worked in two war zones before she joined the TV channel.
media outlet
медіаплатформа
Which media outlet first reported the story?
A small online media outlet reported it first, and then the big channels copied it.
Which media outlet did your parents use to trust most?
They used to trust the national TV channel, but now they prefer online news.
influencer
інфлуенсер
How did your favourite influencer become famous?
She became famous when she posted a funny video that went viral.
What did the influencer use to do before social media?
He used to work as a waiter, and he filmed videos in his free time.
documentary
документальний фільм
What was the last documentary you watched?
I watched a documentary about whales last weekend. It was amazing.
Did you know much about the topic before you watched the documentary?
No, I had never heard about the problem before I watched it.
soap opera
серіал, мило-драма
Did your grandmother use to watch soap operas?
Yes, she used to watch a soap opera every evening at seven.
What was happening in the soap opera when you stopped watching it?
The main character was planning her wedding when I stopped watching.
sitcom
ситком, комедія
Which sitcom made you laugh the most as a child?
Friends made me laugh the most. I watched every episode.
Did anything funny happen while you were watching a sitcom with your family?
Yes, while we were watching, my dad laughed so hard that he fell off the sofa.
chat show
ток-шоу
Who was the host talking to on the chat show when you turned on the TV?
He was talking to a famous actor when I turned on the TV.
Why was the guest on the chat show so nervous?
She was nervous because she had never appeared on live TV before.
reality show
реаліті-шоу
Did you use to watch reality shows?
Yes, I used to watch them every week, but now I find them boring.
Who won the last reality show you watched?
A young singer from Kharkiv won it, and everyone was surprised.
thriller
трилер
What were you doing when the scariest moment of the thriller happened?
I was eating popcorn when the scariest moment happened, and I dropped it all!
Had you guessed the ending before the thriller finished?
No, I hadn't guessed it. The ending was a total surprise.
quiz show
вікторина
Did you ever take part in a quiz show?
Yes, I took part in a school quiz show last year and my team came second.
Which quiz show did your family use to watch together?
We used to watch 'Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?' every Saturday.
breaking news
термінові новини
What were you doing when you heard the breaking news?
I was walking to school when my phone showed the breaking news.
How did people react to the breaking news?
Everyone stopped working and watched the TV in silence.
series
серіал, серія
Which series did you finish last month?
I finished a crime series last month. I watched all three seasons in two weeks.
What series did you use to love when you were a kid?
I used to love a cartoon series about pirates.
episode
епізод, серія
Why didn't you understand the new episode?
I didn't understand it because I hadn't watched the previous episode.
Did you fall asleep while you were watching the last episode?
Yes, I fell asleep while I was watching it, so I missed the ending.
subtitles
субтитри
Did you use to watch films with subtitles?
I used to watch them with Ukrainian subtitles, but now I use English ones.
Was it difficult to get used to reading subtitles?
It was difficult at first, but I'm used to it now. I don't even notice them.
schedule
розклад, графік
Did the TV channel change its schedule last week?
Yes, it moved my favourite show to 10 pm because of the football.
Why did you miss the programme?
I missed it because the channel had changed the schedule without telling anyone.
channel
канал
Which channel were you watching when the electricity went off?
I was watching a music channel when the electricity went off.
How many channels did people use to have on TV?
People used to have only three or four channels, so they didn't have much choice.
ratings
рейтинги
Why did the show's ratings fall last season?
The ratings fell because the writers killed the most popular character.
Had the show's ratings already dropped before the channel cancelled it?
Yes, the ratings had dropped a lot before the channel cancelled it.
commercial
рекламний ролик
What were you doing while the commercials were on?
I was making a sandwich while the commercials were on.
Did there use to be a lot of commercials during films?
Yes, there used to be lots of commercials, so a film took three hours to watch.
coverage
висвітлення, репортаж
What did you think of the TV coverage of the Olympics?
I thought the coverage was great. They showed every event live.
Was news coverage different before social media?
Yes, news coverage used to be slower, but journalists used to check facts more carefully.
eyewitness
очевидець
What was the eyewitness doing when the accident happened?
He was waiting at the bus stop when the two cars crashed.
What had the eyewitness seen before the police arrived?
She had seen a man running away before the police arrived.
bias
упередженість
When did you first notice bias in a news report?
I first noticed it when two channels described the same event completely differently.
Did you use to believe everything you read, without thinking about bias?
Yes, I used to believe everything, but now I always check other sources.
press conference
прес-конференція
What happened while the minister was giving the press conference?
While she was speaking, a protester ran onto the stage.
Why did the coach hold a press conference?
He held it because the team had lost five matches in a row.
scoop
сенсаційний репортаж
How did the journalist get the scoop?
She got the scoop when a secret source sent her the documents.
Had any other newspaper published the story before her scoop?
No, nobody had published it before. It was a real scoop.
freelance
фрілансер, позаштатний
Did your aunt use to work full-time before she went freelance?
Yes, she used to work for a magazine, but she went freelance three years ago.
What was she doing when she got her first freelance job?
She was travelling in Italy when an editor asked her to write a freelance article.
censorship
цензура
What happened to newspapers under censorship in the USSR?
The government controlled them, and journalists couldn't write the truth.
What did people use to do to avoid censorship?
They used to copy banned books by hand and share them secretly.
надійний, достовірний
Why did you stop trusting that website?
I stopped trusting it because it had published false news several times. It wasn't reliable.
Which news source did you use to think was reliable?
I used to think one Telegram channel was reliable, but then I found out it spread fake news.
rumour
чутка, плітка
Where were you when you first heard the rumour?
I was sitting in the canteen when my friend told me the rumour.
Was the rumour true?
No. Someone had invented it as a joke, but everyone believed it.
propaganda
пропаганда
How did propaganda work in the Second World War?
Governments used posters, films and radio to control what people believed.
What did Soviet propaganda use to tell people?
It used to tell people that life in the USSR was better than anywhere else.
exclusive
ексклюзивний матеріал
Which magazine got the exclusive interview with the star?
A small fashion magazine got the exclusive, and it sold out in one day.
Why was the interview an exclusive?
Because the star had never talked to any other journalist about it.
investigation
розслідування
What were the journalists doing during the investigation?
They were checking documents and interviewing witnesses for months.
What did the investigation find?
It found that the company had hidden its pollution data for years.
anonymous
анонімний
Why did the source stay anonymous?
She stayed anonymous because she was afraid of losing her job.
Did people use to write anonymous letters to newspapers?
Yes, people used to send anonymous letters when they wanted to report a problem.
leaked
витік інформації
How did the documents get leaked to the press?
An employee copied them and sent them to a journalist.
Had anyone known about the problem before the documents leaked?
Only a few managers had known about it before the documents leaked.
trustworthy
достовірний, надійний
Did newspapers use to be more trustworthy than social media?
Many people think so. Newspapers used to check every fact before printing.
Were you reading a trustworthy source when you found that story?
No, I was scrolling a random website when I found it, so I checked it again later.
athletics
легка атлетика
Do you do athletics, or do you play a team sport?
I do athletics. I run the 400 metres, and I also play volleyball at weekends.
Is athletics harder than swimming?
I think athletics is harder because the training is more intense and more boring.
tournament
турнір
Was the last tournament exciting, or were you bored?
It was really exciting! I was so excited that I couldn't sit down.
What is the most important tournament in your sport?
The most important tournament is the World Cup. It's the biggest and the most famous.
champion
чемпіон
Who is the greatest champion in your favourite sport?
I think Usyk is the greatest champion in boxing. He's the most disciplined fighter I know.
Is the new champion as strong as the old one?
No, she isn't as strong, but she's much faster and smarter.
spectator
глядач
How did the spectators feel when their team lost?
They felt disappointed. It was a really disappointing result.
Are there more spectators at football matches than at basketball games?
Yes, there are far more spectators at football matches. The stadiums are much bigger.
competitor
суперник, учасник змагань
Was your competitor unfair or dishonest?
No, he wasn't unfair at all. He was very honest, but a bit impatient.
Who was the toughest competitor in the race?
A girl from Lviv was the toughest competitor. She was the fastest runner in the final.
record
рекорд
What is the most impressive world record you know?
Usain Bolt's 100-metre record is the most impressive. He's the fastest man in history.
Is it getting harder to break records?
Yes. The faster athletes become, the harder it is to break records.
qualify
кваліфікуватись
How did the team feel when they qualified for the final?
They were amazed. It was the most amazing moment of the season.
Is it easier to qualify for the Olympics or for the World Championship?
It's more difficult to qualify for the Olympics because there are fewer places.
defeat
поразка; перемогти
Was the defeat disappointing for the fans?
Yes, it was very disappointing, and the fans were frustrated with the coach.
Was this defeat worse than last year's?
Yes, it was much worse. We lost 5–0, and last year we only lost 2–1.
penalty
пенальті, штраф
Was the penalty fair, or was it unfair?
I think it was unfair. The player didn't touch him, so the decision was incorrect.
How did the goalkeeper feel before the penalty?
He felt terrified, but he saved it. It was an amazing moment.
referee
суддя, рефері
Do you think the referee was dishonest?
No, he wasn't dishonest, but he was inexperienced and made some illogical decisions.
Are referees stricter now than in the past?
Yes, they're much stricter now because video technology makes it easier to see mistakes.
tactics
тактика
Which tactics are more effective: attacking or defensive?
Attacking tactics are more exciting, but defensive tactics are often more effective.
Were the players confused by the coach's tactics?
Yes, the tactics were confusing, so the players looked lost.
coaching
тренерство, коучинг
Is good coaching more important than talent?
I think good coaching is just as important as talent, but hard work is the most important thing.
Was the coaching last season unprofessional?
Yes, it was quite unprofessional. The training was disorganised and irregular.
sponsorship
спонсорство
Do bigger clubs get more sponsorship than smaller ones?
Yes. The bigger the club, the more sponsorship it gets.
What is the most famous sponsorship deal you know?
The most famous one I know is between a sports brand and Cristiano Ronaldo.
victory
перемога
How did you feel after your team's victory?
I was thrilled. It was the most thrilling victory of the year.
Was this victory easier than the last one?
No, it was harder. The other team was much stronger this time.
squad
команда, склад
Is this year's squad better than last year's?
Yes, it's much better. The players are younger and fitter.
What do the players in the squad do in the off-season?
Some players go cycling, some do yoga and a few play golf.
injury
травма, поранення
What was the worst injury you had as a child?
The worst injury I had was a broken arm when I fell off my bike.
Was it frightening when you got injured?
Yes, it was frightening, and I was worried that I couldn't play again.
sprain
розтягнення (м'язів)
Is a sprain less serious than a fracture?
Yes, a sprain is usually less serious, and it heals more quickly.
Did you get the sprain when you were playing basketball or going running?
I got it when I was playing basketball. I landed badly after a jump.
fracture
перелом
Was the fracture painful, and was the recovery tiring?
The fracture was extremely painful, and I felt exhausted after every physiotherapy session.
Does a fracture take longer to heal than a sprain?
Yes, a fracture takes much longer, usually six weeks or more.
recovery
відновлення
Is recovery faster for younger athletes?
Yes, younger athletes usually recover faster than older ones.
Is it impossible to play during recovery?
It isn't impossible, but it's unwise. You can make the injury worse.
fitness
фізична форма
What do you do to improve your fitness? Do you go jogging or do yoga?
I go jogging three times a week and do yoga on Sundays.
Are you fitter now than you were last year?
Yes, I'm much fitter. My fitness is better than ever.
prevent
